name: Portable Bluetooth speaker
description: The villa doesn't list one among its amenities, and it'll get used constantly — pool days, BBQ nights, getting ready to go out.

name: Deck of cards + one or two compact group games
description: Good options for this group size: Cards Against Humanity-style party games, Codenames, Sushi Go, or a simple poker set given the group's fine-dining/adventurous vibe suggests they wouldn't mind a bit of gambling for fun.

name: Inflatable pool float(s)
description: Not worth checking a bag over — a cheap (€5-10) buy from a Noto shop or supermarket (ARD Discount / Sisa) once you're there.

name: Cooler / cool bag
description: Useful for beach days (drinks, the fish you buy at the Saturday market) and for BBQ nights — often cheap to pick up locally rather than pack.

name: Bocce / pétanque set
description: The villa's garden is described as spacious and Mediterranean — a small set makes for an easy after-dinner activity and is cheap and available locally.

name: Frisbee or spikeball set
description: For the beach days — doesn't take much suitcase space.
